verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to current and past incidents and surfaces suggestions in Command Center and Slack, which covers the 'similar past incidents' part without a human asking. Nothing shows the AI investigating probable cause or correlating changes and telemetry; fhcli records change events, but no evidence connects them to AI analysis. Missing for 10: AI probable-cause or root-cause analysis, correlation of change/deploy events, correlation of telemetry/monitoring data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to your existing and previous incidents and makes suggestions in the Command Center and Slack.
